title: Surreal Mouse and Dream Tree
description: A giant red mouse sits on a sandy dune beside a small silhouetted human figure, both gazing at a massive twisted tree whose branches stretch across a twilight sky. The tree is covered in glowing orbs containing miniature scenes, hanging red chili peppers, and intricate webs, overlooking a neon-lit futuristic city with glowing highways beneath a large pink moon.
prompt: A massive gnarled tree grows from a sand dune, its branches filled with glowing orbs containing tiny scenes and hanging red chili peppers connected by webs. In the foreground a large bright red mouse and a small silhouetted human stand watching. Below stretches a glowing cyberpunk city with neon highways under a giant pink full moon in a starry twilight sky with orange and purple gradients.
